strings.Mods descargados en la carpeta mods: Mods downloaded in the mods folder
strings.Plugins descargados en la carpeta plugin: Plugins downloaded in the plugins folder
strings.Elige una seccion. Puedes regresar aqui: Choose a section. You can come back here at any time without leaving configuration.
strings.Memoria asignada, propiedades del servid: Allocated memory, server properties and project image.
strings.Respaldos automaticos y manuales del mun: Automatic and manual world and player backups.
strings.Cambiar server.jar entre Vanilla, Snapsh: Switch server.jar between Vanilla, Snapshots, Plugins and Modded.
strings.Los cambios de RAM, server.properties y: RAM, server.properties and server.jar changes apply when the server starts. Backups and versions now live inside this section.
strings.Selecciona un tema. Overworld/Nether/End: Choose a theme. Overworld/Nether/End only change colors, nothing else.
Theme saved and applied to the whole app.
strings.Personaliza la apariencia, los respaldos: Customize the appearance, cloud backups and language.
strings.Cambia la paleta de colores de toda la a: Change the color palette of the whole application.
strings.Cambia el idioma de la interfaz o agrega: Change the interface language or add a new file.
strings.Comprueba si hay una version nueva publi: Check whether a new version has been published on GitHub.
strings.Deshabilitado temporalmente. Estara disp: Temporarily disabled. It will be available in a future version.
strings.Personaliza la apariencia, el idioma y l: Customize the appearance, language and updates.
strings.Se consulta la ultima release publicada: The latest release published on GitHub is checked. If a new version exists, a download link is shown; the app does not update itself.
strings.Pulsa BUSCAR ACTUALIZACIONES para compro: Press CHECK FOR UPDATES to look for a new version.
strings.La validacion es experimental: comprueba: Validation is experimental: it checks that the API responds and that credentials have the expected format. It does not upload files yet.
strings.El nombre de la app no cambia con el idi: The app name does not change with the language.
strings.Los archivos de idioma son JSON editable: Language files are editable JSON. Each key is the Spanish text and the value is its translation.
strings.Cambia la RAM asignada al servidor.jar: Change the RAM allocated to server.jar
Send commands directly to the server. Use TAB for history.
strings.Escribe un comando (ej: say, list, op, g: Type a command (e.g. say, list, op, gamemode...)
strings.Los comandos van directamente al stdin d: Commands go directly to the server stdin if it is running with this panel.
strings.Selecciona el idioma que quieres usar en: Select the language you want to use in the app. You can change it later in App Configuration > Language.
strings.El resto del asistente usara el idioma q: The rest of the setup will use the language you choose.
strings.Playit.GG crea el tunel publico para que: Playit.GG creates the public tunnel so your players can join without opening ports. First we set up Playit, then the Minecraft server.
strings.SI, YA LO TENGO INSTALADO: YES, I ALREADY HAVE IT INSTALLED
strings.NO, AUN NO LO TENGO: NO, I DON'T HAVE IT YET
The official download page will open. Install the Windows version and come back when it finishes. Do not close this setup.
strings.Nota: el panel solo necesita playit.exe;: Note: the panel only needs playit.exe; the playitd service is installed together with the app.
playit.exe is used to start the tunnel. The default folder is C:\Program Files\playit_gg\bin.
strings.Si eliges otra ubicacion, selecciona dir: If you choose another location, select the playit.exe file directly. The playitd service is installed together with the app.
strings.No se encontro playit.exe. Descargalo o: playit.exe was not found. Download it or select the file.
strings.No existe el archivo indicado:: The specified file does not exist:
strings.Playit necesita una cuenta vinculada par: Playit needs a linked account to create the agent and the tunnel for your server.
strings.SI, MI CUENTA YA ESTA VINCULADA: YES, MY ACCOUNT IS ALREADY LINKED
strings.NO, AUN NO LA HE VINCULADO: NO, I HAVEN'T LINKED IT YET
strings.Abre Playit.GG y sigue el enlace que mue: Open Playit.GG and follow the link shown by the app. You will need to open a link similar to playit.gg/claim/xxxxx, sign in and authorize the device.
strings.Pasos: 1) abre Playit.GG, 2) copia o abr: Steps: 1) open Playit.GG, 2) copy or open the playit.gg/claim/xxxxx link, 3) sign in and authorize the computer, 4) come back here and continue.
strings.¿Ya tienes un server.jar con su configur: Do you already have a server.jar with its basic configuration?
strings.Si ya tienes un servidor funcionando pod: If you already have a working server we can import it. If you start from scratch, we help you download the version, Java and accept the EULA.
strings.SI, YA TENGO UN SERVIDOR: YES, I ALREADY HAVE A SERVER
strings.¿Quieres una instalacion con varios serv: Do you want a multi-server setup?
strings.Podemos guardar tus proyectos dentro de: We can keep your projects inside {0}. That way you can switch servers at any time from the title bar.
strings.Se movera la carpeta completa (mundo, pl: The whole folder (world, plugins, configuration and server.jar) will be moved to {0}. You can add more servers there later.
strings.El panel trabajara directamente en la ca: The panel will work directly in the folder where you already have server.jar. You can also import it later from 'Change server'.
strings.Se creara una carpeta dentro de RaizServ: A folder will be created inside RaizServer ({0}). We choose the version, download server.jar and prepare the EULA.
strings.Acepto el EULA de Minecraft (obligatorio: I accept the Minecraft EULA (required to start the server).
strings.Descargar Java automaticamente si esta v: Download Java automatically if this version needs it.
strings.El servidor se creara con eula=true, ser: The server will be created with eula=true, a basic server.properties and run.bat. You can change everything from the panel.
strings.El panel ya tiene todo lo necesario para: The panel now has everything needed to start your server and open the Playit tunnel.
strings.No se encontraron versiones. Revisa tu c: No versions were found. Check your connection.
strings.No se encontro un JDK {0} para Windows x: No JDK {0} was found for Windows x64.
strings.Debes aceptar el EULA de Minecraft para: You must accept the Minecraft EULA to create the server.
strings.Ya existe una carpeta con ese nombre en: A folder with that name already exists in RaizServer. Choose another name.
strings.El nombre contiene caracteres no permiti: The name contains characters that are not allowed.
strings.Reinicia el servidor cada cierto tiempo: Restarts the server periodically with warnings and a backup first.
strings.Reinicios programados con aviso y backup: Scheduled restarts with warnings and a backup first
strings.Reinicio ciclico con backup previo y avi: Cyclic restart with a backup and player warnings
strings.Al llegar la hora: se crea un backup, se: When the time comes: a backup is created, the server stops and then starts again. Players receive action bar warnings at 10 min, 5 min, 1 min, 30 s and during the 5 to 1 second countdown. The 10 and 5 minute warnings are also sent to chat.
strings.Cuenta atras del proximo reinicio progra: Countdown to the next scheduled restart
strings.Reiniciando el servidor y su backup: Restarting the server and its backup
strings.El ciclo solo corre con el servidor inic: The cycle only runs while the server is started from the panel.
strings.El servidor se detiene y vuelve a inicia: The server stops and starts again automatically.
strings.Inicia el servidor desde el panel para r: Start the server from the panel to resume the countdown.
strings.Avisos por action bar y chat: 10 y 5 min: Action bar and chat warnings at 10 and 5 minutes. Automatic backup before the restart.
strings.Selecciona un tema. Overworld/Nether/End: Choose a theme. Overworld/Nether/End only change colors. Custom panoramas will arrive in a future version.
